title: Levy
description: An amount owners are required to pay: regular strata fees under a budget, or a special levy approved by the owners.
x-validationRules: The sum of allocations[].amount should equal totalAmount, allowing for rounding.
approvedByResolutionId is expected when levyType is specialLevy.
x-legalReviewNotes: Confirm treatment of instalments, interest and refunds of unused special levy money.

id.description: Stable identifier of this Levy record.

strataCorporationId.description: The strata corporation this record belongs to.

x-enumDescriptions.strataFee: Regular strata fees (monthly contributions) under the budget.
x-enumDescriptions.specialLevy: Special levy approved by the owners.

allocationBasis.description: How the total is shared between strata lots.

x-enumDescriptions.other: Another basis approved by the owners.

budgetId.description: Budget the strata fees are based on, when levyType is strataFee.

dueDate.description: Date payment is due, or the first due date when paid in instalments.

allocations.description: Amount payable by each strata lot.

amount.description: Amount payable by this strata lot.

extensions.description: Implementation-specific data, namespaced by reverse domain.
